name: s2c-ide-bridge
description: Click an element in your running app to reveal its line here; move the cursor here to highlight the element there.

sketch2code.devServerUrl.description: Base URL of the Vite dev server running @s2c/vite-plugin.

sketch2code.enabled.description: Connect to the dev server's editor bridge.

sketch2code.cursorSync.description: Report the cursor position so the browser overlay highlights the matching element.

sketch2code.editorName.description: Label the browser overlay shows for this editor.
